name: James Creek RV Resort
note: RJourney-run campground minutes west of Raystown Lake (Huntingdon Co): 20/30/50-amp pull-through and back-in sites, many seasonal in the wooded ring, plus pool, mini golf, restaurant and cabins; near Seven Points and the Allegrippis bike trails. RV sites from $50/night (2026). Office closed Mon-Tue. Good Sam 8.7; Google 4.3 over 119 reviews. --Claude

name: Tall Oaks Campground
note: Year-round wooded campground near Farmington (Fayette Co), minutes from Ohiopyle's whitewater and Fort Necessity: open field sites plus wooded hillside sites, electric (some water) for RVs, restrooms and showers, firewood delivered. RV electric $45 for two, $18 each extra person (2026). Rafting groups can make weekends loud - ask for a site up the hill; roads get slippery after rain. Google 4.3 over 119 reviews. --Claude

name: Woodward Cave and Campground
note: Campground at Woodward Cave in Penns Valley (Centre Co), the show cave next door offering tours; RV sites around an open meadow, 30A $35/night, 50A $50/night (2026). Near Penns Creek, R.B. Winter and Poe Valley state parks. Google 4.6 over 298 reviews (cave and campground share the listing). --Claude

name: Riverbank Campground
note: One of the newer campgrounds in the Raystown Lake region, on the Juniata River minutes from Huntingdon: every camper site full hookup (water/sewer, 30/50A), from $46/night (2026), online booking; seasonal sites and a dump station too. Class A RVs over 32 ft not accepted; 13'6" bridge clearance on the way in. Google 4.5 over 45 reviews. --Claude

name: French Creek Farms
note: Farm campground on a meadow loop along French Creek near Utica (Venango Co), with private kayak/canoe access; 19 sites, no hookups (fresh-water hand pump, toilets). 2026 rates: field sites from $30, creek-bank waterfront sites from $35, large sites from $45; cabin and cottage too. Online booking only - no cash walk-ins. Near Franklin and the Sandy Creek and Oil Creek trails. Google 4.9 over 37 reviews. --Claude
